name: Bahnhofstrasse
overview: Bahnhofstrasse is one of the world's most expensive and exclusive shopping streets, stretching 1.4 kilometers from Zurich's main railway station to Lake Zurich. It's renowned for luxury shopping, Swiss watches, and high-end boutiques.
history: Built in the 1860s as part of the demolition of Zurich's medieval fortifications, Bahnhofstrasse was designed as a grand boulevard. It quickly became the city's premier commercial street and remains one of the most expensive retail locations globally.
highlights: Luxury Swiss watch boutiques (Rolex, Patek Philippe, Vacheron Constantin)
High-end fashion stores and department stores
Historic Café Sprüngli with famous Luxemburgerli macarons
tips: Window shopping is free and enjoyable even without buying. Visit Sprüngli café for authentic Swiss confections. Tram lines run along the street for easy navigation. Best for strolling in good weather.
